description: Rules for user-created exercises. A custom exercise copies a library exercise (the base template), then the user changes ratings with the level picker, modifiers and feel feedback. All values are clamped to 0..1. Group ratings in muscles[] are recomputed as the max of their heads (regionGroup) after every change. Custom exercises are always marked estimated: true.
id_format: custom-<slug of name>-<6 random base36 chars>. Each machine or gym variant gets its own id so history stays machine-specific. Duplicating makes a new id.
rating_levels_note: Show the picker per head region. When a template value is between levels, preselect the nearest level, but keep the exact number until the user changes it. Advanced field: exact 0 to 1, step 0.05.

stretch.label: Hardest when the muscle is stretched
stretch.note: Sets stretch_biased: true, which counts toward the missing-stretch check. Ratings aren't changed, because stretch loading affects how much the muscle grows, not which muscle does the work.

top.label: Hardest at the top (squeezed)
top.note: Lower growth stimulus per set. Subtract 0.1 from every head rated 0.75 or higher.

modifiers.apply_order: template ratings, then the position delta, then the resistance curve, then feel nudges. Clamp each head to 0..1, then recompute groups.

rules: Nudges only touch heads the user taps. Each nudge moves at most per_session_cap per session, and a head never drifts more than total_drift_cap from its value after modifiers.
A head that starts at 0 can be nudged up to 0.25 at most (minor). That keeps a pump from inventing a primary mover.
Feel feedback only works on custom exercises. Library exercises stay fixed.
Store nudges separately as feelOffsets so 'Reset feel adjustments' restores the post-modifier values exactly.

estimated.flag: estimated: true on every custom exercise
estimated.map_style: lighter tint with diagonal hatching on regions where that day's or week's load comes mostly (over 50%) from estimated exercises
estimated.readout_note: Includes estimated ratings from custom exercises.

validation: The name is required and must be unique among custom exercises.
At least one head must be at minor or higher.
Warn, but allow it, if more than 4 heads are primary. That usually means the ratings are overestimated.
